name: Delete-Chunk-Tool-reforged
title: Chunk Delete Tool Reforged
author: NotRexButCaesar, FactorioParanoidal
description: Administrators delete chunks with a selection tool: the chosen chunks are highlighted and deleted only after confirmation. A normal selection keeps chunks with player buildings, ruins and legendary ruins; Shift deletes them too (never chunks with a character). Map trimming deletes in one go all chunks far from buildings, outside radar range and without pollution, to make the save smaller. A deleted chunk comes back without new ruins and with no more ore than it had; chunks deleted with the tool come back without enemy bases. Fork of Chunk Delete Tool by NotRexButCaesar.
